title: SEO - Intern
description:
2Base Technologies is a custom software development company with over 16 years of delivery experience, working as an enterprise solutions partner for clients in the United States, the United Kingdom and other global markets. Our work spans custom software development, AI implementation, legacy system modernization and operational transformation.
 



 We are building our marketing function, and organic search sits at the centre of it. This internship is a place on that build. You will learn how search works on a real website with real commercial stakes, under people who do this for a living, and you will do actual work rather than shadow someone doing it.
 



  





 What This Role Exists to Do
 



 Organic search at 2Base is being built to bring buyers in the United States and the United Kingdom to our website at the point where they are deciding who to hire. That takes a large volume of well\-targeted pages, a clean technical base and constant checking of what is working.
 



 Search work divides into three areas and this role covers all three.
 



 On\-page is what is on the page itself: the words it targets, how it is titled and structured, how it links to the rest of the site.
 



 Off\-page is the authority that comes from other credible websites pointing at it, which is patient work of finding the right sites, writing to real people and following up. Technical is whether search engines can reach, read and index the site at all.
 



 You will work across all three. The Organic Growth and SEO Specialist sets the direction and the quality standard, and reviews what you produce. You do a great deal of the work.
 



  





 Internship Duration: 6 Months
 



  





 What You Will Do
 



 On\-page SEO
 



 • Keyword research for assigned service areas: finding the terms, sorting them by what the searcher is trying to do, and writing a short note on why each one matters to 2Base
 



 • On\-page work on live pages: page titles, meta descriptions, heading structure, image alt text and internal links, made against a brief and checked before publishing
 



 • Internal linking across the site, so that the pages that matter commercially are reachable and connected
 



 • Competitor checks on assigned terms: who is ranking, what their page does, and what is missing from ours
 



 • Working with the Content and Thought Leadership Specialist, who writes the pages. You brief on the search side and check the published page against the brief.
 



  





 Off\-page SEO
 



 • Prospecting link targets: finding relevant sites, publications, partner sites and resource pages in the United States and the United Kingdom, and putting each one forward for approval with a short note on why it is worth approaching
 



 • Outreach: writing and sending the approach emails, following up on a defined schedule, and handling the replies, including the ones that say no
 



 • Keeping the outreach record: who was contacted, when, what was said, what happened, and what is due for follow\-up. An outreach programme without a record is the same programme run twice.
 



 • Tracking placements: confirming links went live, that they point where they should, and that they stay live
 



 • Monitoring the backlink profile: watching what is arriving and flagging anything low quality, spam\-driven or unrelated
 



 • Toxic link work: identifying harmful or manipulative links, assembling the evidence for each one, and preparing the disavow file for the Organic Growth and SEO Specialist to review and submit
 



 • Competitor backlink analysis: looking at who links to competitors and does not link to us, and turning that gap into a prospect list
 



 • Directory and listing consistency: making sure 2Base appears with the same name, address and details wherever it is listed
 



  





 Technical SEO
 



 • Running the recurring site audit and turning it into a fix list a developer can act on: broken links, redirect chains, missing or duplicate metadata, thin or orphaned pages
 



 • Crawling and indexing checks in Google Search Console: what is indexed, what is excluded and why, what has dropped out since last week
 



 • Sitemap and robots.txt checks, and flagging anything that is blocking a page that should be found
 



 • Page speed and Core Web Vitals reporting, with the worst offenders identified and passed to the development team with the evidence
 



 • Mobile usability checks and basic structured data validation
 



 • Documenting each finding clearly enough that a developer can act on it without coming back with questions. You diagnose and document; the development team implements.
 



  





 Across all three
 



 • Weekly monitoring in Google Search Console and Google Analytics 4: what moved, what broke, what is newly indexed, and what has dropped out
 



 • The monthly organic summary: traffic, ranking movement, pages live, links gained, Search Console health, written up rather than sent as a set of screenshots
 



 • A running note of what changed on the site and when, so that a change in the numbers can be traced back to a cause
 



 Two things are worth saying plainly. Everything you publish and every email you send is reviewed before it goes out for the first three months, so you will not be working unsupervised on a live site. And 2Base does not buy links or pay for placement, at any price, on any site. Nothing in this role involves it.
 



  





 Education
 



 Final\-year student or recent graduate in marketing, business, communications, computer applications, engineering or a related field.
 



 BBA, BCA, MCA, MBA, BTech and similar qualifications are all in scope.
 



 We are not filtering on the degree title. Candidates from other backgrounds who can show real work with search are considered on that work.
 



  





 Foundations
 



 • A working understanding of what search engines do and why a page ranks. You should be able to explain the difference between what someone is searching for and the words they type.
 



 • Comfort with numbers in a spreadsheet: sorting, filtering, a simple formula, and reading a trend without needing it explained.
 



 • Clear written English, and specifically the ability to write a short email to a stranger that they might actually answer. Much of this role is written approach and follow\-up.
 



 • Any hands\-on contact with Google Analytics, Google Search Console, SEMrush, Ahrefs, WordPress or a similar tool is useful and is not required. We will teach the tools.
 



  





 Good to Have
 



 • A blog, a site, a channel or a store of your own that you have tried to get found, however small, and whatever happened to it
 



 • Any experience of approaching strangers in writing and getting a reply: outreach, sales, fundraising, event sponsorship, college placement work, freelance pitching. The setting does not matter.
 



 • Any coursework, certification or self\-study in digital marketing, analytics or search
 



 • Basic familiarity with HTML page structure
 



 • An interest in how businesses in the United States and the United Kingdom search differently from businesses in India
 



  





 How to Apply
 



 Send your CV to careers@2basetechnologies.com with the subject line: SEO Intern, followed by your name.
 



 In the body of the email, in no more than 200 words, answer one question:
 



 Pick any website you often use, and tell us one thing you would change about it to help more people find it in Google, and why?

description:
**About TwinMind:** 




  





 TwinMind is building an AI "second brain" — an app that passively captures ambient speech (with permission), transcribes it on\-device, and turns your meetings, lectures, and conversations into a personal knowledge graph that powers AI\-generated notes, to\-dos, follow\-up emails, and answers to anything you've heard or said.
 



  





**Why we're different:** 



* **A world\-class founding team:** 
 Founded March 2024 by Daniel George, Sunny Tang, and Mahi Karim — AI scientists whose combined backgrounds span Google X (the Moonshot Factory), applied AI leadership at JPMorgan, Wolfram Research, and a contribution to the Nobel Prize–winning LIGO gravitational\-wave discovery.
* **Backed by top investors:** 
 $9M seed led by Streamlined Ventures, with participation from Sequoia Capital, Rocketship VC, among others
* **Real technical moats:** 
 On\-device \+ cloud audio processing that runs 16–17 hours continuously without draining battery; our proprietary Ear\-3 speech model supports 140\+ languages with speaker diarization, available via API to developers and enterprises.
* **Multi\-surface product:** 
 iOS, Android, Mac, Windows, Apple Watch, and a Chrome extension that adds browser context (email, Slack, Notion) to your second brain.
* **Global traction:** 
 A rapidly growing global user base that has multiplied several\-fold since our seed round. The US is our largest market, with strong organic pull from India, South America, Southeast Asia, Africa and Europe. Professionals make up the majority of our base, with students a strong second segment.
* **Privacy\-first:** 
 We don't train models on user data. Audio is processed locally; transcripts stay on your device unless you opt into cloud backup.



 We monetize via a freemium model (Pro subscription) and are now moving from product\-led early adoption to deliberate, scaled growth. That's where you come in.
 



  





**The Role** 




 You'll own paid acquisition for TwinMind across Google and Meta. That includes running the campaigns, managing budgets, testing creative, and making sure the tracking behind all of it is accurate. Your work will be measured on paying subscribers and MRR, not on clicks or installs. You'll work closely with the Head of Growth, the content/UGC team and our data team.
 



  





**What You'll Do** 



* Plan, launch and scale performance campaigns on Google (Search, YouTube, Performance Max, App campaigns) and Meta (Facebook, Instagram, Advantage\+) for India and the US.
* Manage and scale monthly ad spend, and move budget between channels, markets and campaigns based on what actually converts to paid.
* Optimise for down\-funnel metrics like trial\-to\-paid conversion, CAC, payback period, ROAS and LTV:CAC, rather than surface metrics.
* Run a structured creative testing system with the UGC and content team. You'll brief hooks and angles, analyse creative performance, and quickly kill or scale ads.
* Own conversion tracking end to end: Meta CAPI, Google enhanced conversions, offline/server\-side events, app events (Firebase/MMP), and UTM hygiene. You'll work with the data team to make sure attribution is accurate.
* Build dashboards and weekly reports showing spend, funnel performance and learnings, and turn them into clear recommendations.
* Run landing page and funnel experiments with product and design to improve conversion rates.
* Track platform changes, competitor activity and new ad formats, and bring new ideas to test.



  





**What We're Looking For** 



* 5\+ years in performance marketing, with deep hands\-on experience in both Google Ads and Meta Ads Manager.
* A proven record of managing and scaling at least ₹20L/month in ad spend. You should be able to explain what you scaled, how you did it, and what broke along the way.
* Experience in a consumer (B2C) business, ideally a subscription, app or D2C product where paid conversion was the goal.
* Strong analytical skills. You're comfortable with GA4, spreadsheets and attribution data, and you can tell real performance from platform\-reported noise.
* A good working understanding of tracking setups: pixels, CAPI, GTM, event mapping and app attribution.
* Good creative judgement. You know what makes a performance ad work and can write sharp creative briefs.
* An ownership mindset. You're comfortable in a fast\-moving startup where you'll build systems, not just run them.



  





**Good to Have** 



* Experience running campaigns for US or international audiences.
* Experience with app install and in\-app conversion campaigns (Google App Campaigns, Meta app ads, MMPs such as AppsFlyer or Branch).
* Exposure to SaaS or subscription metrics like MRR, churn and cohort retention.

Job Description
 




  






 Do you enjoy figuring things out, learning new tools, and getting things done without needing every step spelled out?
 




  






 Are you organised, curious, good with data, and the kind of person who notices when something looks slightly off in a spreadsheet or campaign?
 




  






 We’re looking for a Marketing Operations Executive to join our Marketing team and help keep the engine running behind our campaigns, data, systems, and day\-to\-day marketing activity.
 




  






 This is an entry\-level role for someone early in their career, including freshers with the right attitude, who wants hands\-on exposure to marketing operations, digital marketing, CRM, automation, data, reporting, and marketing technology.
 




  






 You’ll learn our tools and processes, work across different parts of the business, and gradually take ownership of more as you grow.
 




  






 Most importantly, we’re looking for someone who doesn’t just tick tasks off a list. Spot a problem? Investigate it. See a better way? Suggest it. Something broken? Help figure it out.
 




  





**About Resonate CX** 




  






 Resonate CX is a fast\-growing Australian SaaS company in the customer\-experience space, working with leading brands across multiple markets.
 




  






 We’re dynamic, curious, supportive and, above all, fun. It’s the kind of environment where you can learn quickly, take on real responsibility, and build your career while riding a rocket ship.
 




  





**What You’ll Do** 




  





**Campaign Execution \& Coordination** 




  




* Help set up, launch, monitor, and coordinate marketing campaigns.
* Keep campaign trackers organised and activities moving on time.



  





**List Building \& Lead Generation** 




  




* Build and maintain prospect and lead lists.
* Research companies, contacts, and decision\-makers.
* Check, clean, and maintain accurate lead data.



  





**Marketing Technology \& Data** 




  




* Work with CRM, spreadsheets, email tools, and marketing platforms.
* Handle data uploads, updates, exports, and basic troubleshooting.
* Keep marketing data organised and help prepare reports.



  





**Problem Solving \& Coordination** 




  




* Spot operational or data issues and help solve them.
* Work with Marketing, Sales, Operations, and Technology teams.
* Own your tasks, manage priorities, and meet deadlines.



  





**What You Bring** 




  




* Comfortable using Excel / Google Sheets and learning digital tools.
* Basic understanding of digital marketing, data, and reporting.
* Curious about CRM, automation, analytics, email platforms, and AI.
* Strong communication skills and attention to detail.
* Organised, proactive, and comfortable juggling multiple tasks.
* A willingness to learn, experiment, ask questions, and figure things out.



  





**Who This Role Is Great For** 




  




* Graduates from any discipline.
* Candidates with 0–3 years of experience in marketing, digital marketing, operations, or related roles.
* Freshers who are switched on, technically comfortable, and eager to learn.
* People interested in the intersection of marketing \+ technology \+ data.



  





**Travel** 




  






 There may be opportunities for a couple of international trips each year, including the chance to visit our Sydney office and travel overseas for our annual company meeting.
 




  





  






 You’ll get hands\-on experience across campaigns, CRM, marketing technology, lead generation, data, reporting, and automation, with room to grow into Marketing Operations, Digital Marketing, Growth Marketing, Analytics, or Sales Operations.
 




  





**If you’re looking for a role where you can learn fast, solve real problems, work with an international team, and grow with a company that’s moving quickly, we’d love to hear from you.**

description:
**Key Responsibilities** 




**1\. Business \& Marketing Strategy** 




 •     Build and own the marketing plan for the Healthcare vertical – Hospitals, Treatment Centres and Clinics – aligned with Group Marketing strategy and GM Healthcare's business priorities.
 



 •     Identify target patient segments and market opportunities across the network to grow patient volumes and revenue.
 



 •     Track marketing's contribution to business outcomes – patient acquisition, revenue, retention – not just campaign activity.
 



**2\. Digital Marketing – the primary growth channel** 




 •     Own digital marketing end\-to\-end for the vertical: SEO, SEM, social media, content, email/WhatsApp marketing and marketing automation.
 



 •     Own the network's websites and digital platforms across Hospitals, Treatment Centres and Clinics, and drive lead quality and conversion, not just traffic and reach.
 



 •     Build retention programmes – email/WhatsApp follow\-up, loyalty and re\-engagement – to improve repeat visits and patient lifetime value.
 



 •     Build and protect the network's online reputation – reviews, ratings and patient sentiment – across all locations.
 



 •     Track digital performance (cost per lead, cost per patient, ROI) and course\-correct campaigns in real time; this channel should carry the largest share of marketing time and budget.
 



**3\. Activation \& On\-Ground Initiatives** 




 •     Plan and run activation initiatives – health camps, wellness and awareness drives, corporate and community outreach, patient engagement events – to build visibility and drive footfall across the network.
 



 •     Build referral and partnership programmes with doctors, corporates and local healthcare providers.
 



 •     Own an activation calendar aligned to seasonal and local market opportunities across Hospitals, Treatment Centres and Clinics, and measure footfall/conversion from each initiative.
 



**4\. Market Research \& Competitive Intelligence** 




 •     Track competitor marketing activity, pricing and positioning across the Ayurveda and wellness healthcare category.
 



 •     Conduct market research on patient preferences, emerging treatment and category trends, and catchment\-level opportunities.
 



 •     Use research and competitive intelligence to inform strategy, campaigns and new market entry decisions – not as a one\-off exercise.
 



**5\. Brand \& Cross\-Vertical Synergy** 




 •     Ensure brand positioning across the Hospitals network, Treatment Centres and Clinics is consistent with Group brand guidelines
 



 •     Coordinate with the Marketing Manager and other vertical marketing leads to maintain a unified brand experience
 



**6\. Marketing Collateral \& Communication Material** 




 •     Design and produce all marketing collateral required across the network – LBLs, brochures, standees, signage, patient education material and digital creatives – consistent with brand guidelines.
 



 •     Manage design/creative agencies for collateral production, and ensure timely availability of the right material at every location.
 



**7\. PR, Content \& Stakeholder Management** 




 •     Manage PR, media relationships and content – patient stories, doctor\-led content, educational material – to build credibility and visibility.
 



 •     Work with doctors, therapists and leadership across Hospitals, Treatment Centres and Clinics to keep marketing aligned with clinical offerings.
 



 •     Build relationships with corporate, government and tourism partners to grow health tourism.
 



**8\. Budget \& Performance** 




 •     Manage the marketing budget and agency/vendor relationships, with digital marketing and activation receiving priority allocation.
 



 •     Report marketing ROI, digital performance and patient acquisition metrics to GM Healthcare and the Marketing Manager.
 



**Desired Qualifications \& Experience** 




 •     8–12 years in marketing/brand roles, with demonstrated ownership of business or P\&L\-linked outcomes – not only campaign execution.
 



 •     Strong, hands\-on digital marketing expertise (SEO, SEM, social, content, marketing automation, analytics) – this is a core requirement of the role, not a support skill.
 



 •     Experience planning and running on\-ground activation initiatives, and converting them into measurable footfall/patient acquisition.
 



 •     Experience with market research and competitive intelligence tracking, and using it to shape strategy.
 



 •     Experience managing design/creative agencies for collateral – LBLs, brochures, standees, signage and similar material.
 



 •     Background in consumer\-facing or service\-led businesses; healthcare, hospitality or wellness experience preferred but not mandatory.
 



 •     MBA in Marketing, or equivalent, preferred. Not mandatory for a candidate with the right experience
 



 •     Track record of driving measurable growth in customer/patient acquisition and brand strength.
 



 •     Comfortable operating in a lean, hands\-on marketing team and working closely with clinical and business leadership.

title: Online Sales & Marketing Executive
description:
Online Sales \& Marketing Executive
 



  





 Performance\-Based / Commission \+ Incentives
 



  





 K B S TRADERS \| Kochi, Kerala
 



  





 K B S TRADERS is a growing wholesale \& retail business dealing in Dates, Nuts, Dry Fruits, Spices, Millets, Imported Chocolates and more.
 



  





 We are looking for a results\-driven Online Sales \& Marketing Executive who can take ownership of our online customer acquisition and sales — from creating advertisements to converting enquiries into actual orders.
 



  





 This is not a traditional “social media posting” role.
 



  





 We are looking for someone who understands digital marketing \+ sales \+ conversion and is confident enough to be measured by results.
 



  





 What You’ll Be Responsible For
 



  





 Digital Marketing
 



  





 \* Plan, create and manage online advertising campaigns.
 



 \* Manage Meta Ads, Google Ads and other relevant platforms.
 



 \* Create and test different ad creatives, offers, audiences and campaigns.
 



 \* Monitor ad performance, cost per enquiry, conversion rates and ROAS.
 



 \* Continuously optimize campaigns to improve sales and reduce customer acquisition costs.
 



  





 Website \& Online Sales
 



  





 \* Manage and improve our website from a sales perspective.
 



 \* Ensure products, pricing, offers and content are updated.
 



 \* Identify ways to improve website conversion and customer experience.
 



 \* Track website enquiries, orders and abandoned customers.
 



 \* Work on SEO and other organic methods to increase online visibility.
 



  





 Sales Conversion
 



  





 \* Handle and follow up with online enquiries through WhatsApp, phone and other channels.
 



 \* Convert leads into actual customers.
 



 \* Develop follow\-up systems for customers who enquire but don’t purchase immediately.
 



 \* Identify opportunities for upselling, cross\-selling and repeat purchases.
 



 \* Help build a growing database of online customers.
 



  





 Content \& Offers
 



  





 \* Coordinate or create simple sales\-focused content, product creatives, reels and promotional campaigns.
 



 \* Develop offers and campaigns around our products, seasons and occasions.
 



 \* Test different messaging and positioning to discover what generates the most sales.
 



  





 What We’re Looking For
 



  





 \* Experience in digital marketing, performance marketing or online sales.
 



 \* Hands\-on experience with Meta Ads and Google Ads.
 



 \* Understanding of website analytics, conversion tracking and basic SEO.
 



 \* Strong sales and communication skills.
 



 \* Ability to create or coordinate marketing creatives and content.
 



 \* Comfortable working with numbers, targets and campaign performance.
 



 \* Most importantly: a strong focus on generating actual revenue, not just likes, followers or impressions.
 



  





 Experience with e\-commerce, FMCG, food products, wholesale, retail or D2C businesses will be an advantage.
 



  





 How Success Will Be Measured
 



  





 You will be measured primarily on business results such as:
 



  





 \* Online sales generated
 



 \* Number and quality of customers acquired
 



 \* Conversion rate
 



 \* Cost per acquisition
 



 \* Repeat orders
 



 \* Return on advertising spend (ROAS)
 



 \* Revenue/profit generated from online channels
 



  





 Compensation
 



  





 Performance\-based compensation with commission/incentives linked to results.
 



  





 We are open to discussing a suitable structure based on experience and responsibilities.
 



  





 For the right person, this can become a long\-term role with significant earning potential as online sales grow.
 



  





 Who Should Apply?
 



  





 This role is ideal for someone who thinks:
 



  





 “Give me the products, budget and opportunity — I will figure out how to bring customers and generate sales.”
 



  





 If you are someone who enjoys testing, selling, optimizing and growing numbers, we would like to hear from you.
 



  





 To Apply
 



  





 Please send your CV along with examples of campaigns, websites, online stores or sales results you have worked on.
 



  





 Candidates with proven results are strongly preferred.
